title: 第十四章 楚山河
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林夕看着面露笑容的马洁也跟着笑了笑说道：”好神奇的能力。“

马洁说道：“是啊，只不过我目前知道的只有天蚕以及天蚕的反哺。”

林夕又问道：“只能治愈自身吗？”

马洁摇了摇头说道：“还可以治愈其他人，可是治愈一次，我就会回到最初始的状态。”

孙悦疑惑的看向林夕。林夕说道：“她说的最初始的状态应该就是体内的力量变空。”

”你们都过来，我大致给你们讲一下。“林夕呼唤着他们说道

几位能力者均是过来听着林夕说道：”我们所谓的能力者，无非就是类似于，漫威里面的变种人，也就是我们每个人都会有一个属于自己的能力，比如马洁的天蚕，王翔的控火，孙悦的冰，但是也由特殊的人，比如张常的纯粹的力。“

众人都认真的听着林夕的话，林夕接着说道：”所谓的力量变空，你们可以将我们体内当作有一碗水，每天里面的水都会自然而然的增长。“林夕并没有说后期可以通过吸收变异体的结晶来增加自己的修为，因为他们现在刚刚接受了这个世界的变化，再让他们从恶心的变异体中掏出结晶来吸收，估计会受不了。

林夕将自己上一世的各种经验以及所闻，挑了一些跟他们说完。

众人坐了一会，林夕便开口说道：”我们继续走吧。“

众人点了点头皆是站了起来，跟着林夕向前方走去。

孙悦看着路边随处可见的血液，以及各种各样的尸体，以及已经毁掉的车辆，尤其是当她看到一具已经被掏空的尸体的瞬间，顿时忍不住了，半蹲在地上干呕了起来，林夕见状对着王翔说道：”王翔，麻烦你，路上遇到这种的烧了它。“

王翔点了点头一团火球便向那具尸体飞去，林夕看着尸体上着起的熊熊大火，没有说话，扭头往前走去。

众人不知道走了多久，除了林夕以外的所有人，均是觉得脚底一阵阵的刺痛，明显就是磨出来的水泡，又磨破了。

林夕回过头看了看痛苦的众人，说道：”大家坐下来休息一会吧。“

众人均是松了一口气各自找了干净的地方坐了下来。

孙悦扶着马洁也找了林夕附近的地方做了下来，微微皱眉的揉了揉酸痛的小腿

Lin Xi looked at Ma Jie who was smiling and also smiled and said, "What a magical ability."

Ma Jie said: "Yes, but the only thing I know about right now is the Celestial Silkworm and the Celestial Silkworm's feedback."

Lin Xi asked again: "Can I only heal myself?"

Ma Jie shook her head and said, "I can heal other people, but once I am cured, I will return to my original state."

Sun Yue looked at Lin Xi doubtfully.Lin Xi said: "The initial state she mentioned should be that the power in the body becomes empty."

"You all come here and I'll give you a brief introduction." Lin Xi called to them and said

Several ability users came over and listened to Lin Xi say: "What we call ability users is nothing more than mutants in Marvel. That is, each of us has an ability of our own, such as Ma Jie's Celestial Silkworm, Wang Xiang's fire control, and Sun Yue's ice. But it is also made possible by special people, such as Zhang Chang's pure power."

Everyone listened carefully to Lin Xi's words, and Lin Xi continued: "The so-called power becomes empty. You can think of our bodies as having a bowl of water. The water in it will naturally grow every day." Lin Xi did not say that he could increase his cultivation by absorbing mutant crystals in the future, because they have just accepted the changes in the world. If they are asked to take out crystals from disgusting mutants to absorb them, they will probably not be able to bear it.

Lin Xi selected some of her experiences and what she heard in her previous life and told them.

After everyone sat for a while, Lin Xi said, "Let's keep walking."

Everyone nodded and stood up, following Lin Xi and walking forward.

Sun Yue looked at the blood everywhere on the roadside, as well as various corpses and destroyed vehicles. Especially when she saw a corpse that had been hollowed out, she couldn't help it. She squatted on the ground and retched. When Lin Xi saw this, she said to Wang Xiang: "Wang Xiang, please, burn it if you encounter something like this on the road."

Wang Xiang nodded and a ball of fire flew towards the corpse. Lin Xi looked at the raging fire on the corpse, said nothing, turned and walked forward.

They didn't know how long they had been walking, but everyone except Lin Xi felt a stinging pain in the soles of their feet. It was obviously blisters that had been rubbed out and broken.

Lin Xi looked back at the people in pain and said, "Everyone, please sit down and rest for a while."

Everyone breathed a sigh of relief and found a clean place to sit down.

Sun Yue helped Ma Jie and found a place near Lin Xi to do it. She frowned slightly and rubbed her sore calf.
